weaknesses: The experimental results do not include sufficient comparisons with state-of-the-art methods to validate the claims.
The analysis of the numerical experiments lacks detailed explanations of the metrics used, making it difficult to interpret the results.
The paper does not adequately address the implications of the Polyak-Łojasiewicz condition, leaving a gap in understanding its practical relevance.
strengths: The theoretical framework connecting deep residual networks to neural ODEs is well-articulated and provides a solid foundation for future research.
The paper presents a novel approach to implicit regularization, contributing valuable insights into the training dynamics of deep networks.
The numerical experiments demonstrate the theoretical findings effectively, showcasing the convergence properties of the proposed methods.
